_comment: Stable ids for the songs in Other Songs, keyed by their file name in songs/.
The book is displayed alphabetically, so a song’s position moves whenever
another is added or removed — Amazing Grace has already gone from 5 to 2.
Anything that stored a position (a starred song, a recent, the ribbon
bookmark, a sync code) then pointed at a different song. These ids never
move, so those references stay true.
Assigned on first build and never reused. Commit this file; regenerating it
from scratch would renumber everything and break exactly what it protects.
